text: Just got another non-planar quad betrayal. both sides have identical verts but [Image #1] look
resolution: Fixed the non-planar mirrored-quad betrayal at the topology layer. Equal-length diagonals were an unresolved tie: full loop reversal rotated the mirror anchor, so both sides chose loop diagonal 0-2 but those indices named opposite physical edges. EditMesh faces and Zig indexed faces now carry the chosen diagonal as stable vertex-id topology; imports recover the actual shared triangle edge once, vertex remaps preserve it, mirror/symmetrize copy it explicitly, and winding reversal keeps corner zero anchored. Added the same exact saddle-quad mirror regression in TS and Zig. Verified focused TS 8/8, Zig test-mesh-edit, diff checks, and a full ReleaseFast editor ship build.
